propositions: Core modules outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py contain hardcoded Jira adapter lazy-load key literals that execute vendor code regardless of configured backend.
Jira ADF decoding and comment truncation must be routed through backend port roles (FieldSanitizer.fit_comment and InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text) to achieve backend-neutral separation.

The outbound comment-diff normalization path and inbound apply-path defense (bug 1bb2-5da5: raw ADF dict never reaches EDIT event) must both delegate through InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text for consistency.
FieldSanitizer gains fit_comment (pure truncation, no warning) for comment-diff comparison and sanitize_comment (existing, with warning) for send-side hardening.

Literal key sweep gate (test_backend_neutrality.py) must enforce zero adapters.jira strings in core modules except inbound_fields.py (Jira InboundMapper impl) with documented exemption and follow-up ticket reference.

The public function inbound_translate._normalize_adf_body must remain re-exported and behavior-identical while internally routing through the port; three vendor-internal names are deleted from applier.py re-exports.
